The '''Trandoshan airspeeder''' was a combat [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], led by its [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], funded an [[Trandoshan Army|army]] and [[Trandoshan fleet|navy]] for the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], including [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. Airspeeders were first used during the [[Ground warfare/Legends|planetary]] [[Attack on Kashyyyk|attack]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], during which the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] attacked [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft/Legends|Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercrafts]]. Later, many units protected [[Shu Mai's fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] from the air.<ref name="Kinect" />
